title: Compatibility signal registry and validator for fallback variants
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build a central Compatibility Signal Registry and a lightweight Validator service to produce deterministic parity signals for fallback model variants. The registry will aggregate tokenizer, context-window, KV cache and tooling compatibility indicators and surface a composite confidence score used by Smart Routing to decide fallbacks and by CI gates during model onboarding.
acceptance_criteria: Registry stores compatibility signals (tokenizer, context-length, kv-cache semantics, supported ops) for all model variants in the catalog
Validator service can run deterministic checks against a model binary and emit a normalized signal with confidence meta
Smart Routing accepts registry signals via an API and uses them to block fallbacks with confidence < 0.8
Daily sweep task identifies stale signals (>7 days) and enqueues re-validation jobs
E2E test demonstrates a canary routing policy that falls back only when validator score >= 0.9 and latency SLOs are met
technical_design: Architecture: central registry (Postgres + event-driven write from onboarding pipelines) + validator workers (containerized, CPU/GPU optional) + http API used by routing layer. Validator runs a sequence: tokenizer roundtrip checks, context-capacity probe, KV behavior smoke tests, tooling hook compatibility (e.g., structured output, function call stubs). Each check emits a sub-signal and explainability metadata. Composite score uses weighted aggregation with conservative defaults for unknowns. Registry exposes versioned signals and TTLs. API includes read-only mirror for Dedicated/Private control planes. CLI parity-checker is included for manual ops and PR gating.
telemetry: Emit metrics: validator.run.count, validator.run.duration, validator.score{model,variant}, registry.signal_age, registry.refresh_count. Create dashboard in Console: Compatibility Signals by model, failing checks by type, and routing decisions correlated with scores. Alert: registry.signal_age > 7 days triggers sweep job and on-call page.
tasks: Design DB schema and signal format (Aisha)
Implement validator worker harness and unit tests (Ravi)
Add write integration with model onboarding pipeline (Infra)
Build registry API and access controls (Platform)
Integrate Smart Routing to consult registry during fallback decision (Routing)
Create daily sweep job and retry logic for flaky validators (SRE)
Add e2e canary and CI gate that uses CLI parity-checker (QA)
Docs: runbook for manual re-validation and known-issue catalog (DX)
risks: False positives: overly strict checks could block safe fallbacks leading to capacity issues
False negatives: incomplete validator may miss subtle behavioral drift between variants
Operational cost: running GPU-backed probes for many variants may be expensive
Data privacy: validator checks that execute model binaries must not leak customer prompts in logs
notes: Decision: start with tokenizer roundtrip + context capacity + kv smoke tests — defer full function-calling validation to phase 2
Trade-off: composite scoring favors precision over recall to reduce user-facing regressions; will revisit weights after 1 month of telemetry
We will expose a human-readable explanation string with each signal for SRE/PM troubleshooting
For Private deployments, registry provides a read-only export and a lightweight local validator container to avoid sending binaries off-prem
